purpose: Add independent recent-discovery support for the two research-only traces selected by opportunity_policy_search_v2 without reading terminal outcomes during hour selection.
selection_rule: Eight distinct UTC days immediately before the existing July 25 discovery day; hour advances by three hours per day (02,05,08,11,14,17,20,23). This calendar rule was fixed before Gamma identity lookup, PMXT inspection, label access, or outcome scoring.

bounded_decision.advance_condition: After resealing and replay, a trace may open the already sealed fresh gate only if its replayed Wilson edge exceeds the fixed 0.02 safety margin and total fee-aware PnL remains positive.
bounded_decision.reject_condition: Reject a trace if expanded exact replay has non-positive point edge, non-positive fee-aware PnL, or fails the Wilson advancement gate after the bounded expansion. Do not add more parameter variants in response.
